items.headline: 澤倫斯基、尼坦雅胡訪美
items.context: 美國共和黨參議員林賽·葛拉漢（Lindsey Graham）的告別式，把烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基和以色列總理尼坦雅胡同一天帶到了華府，兩人分別到白宮見了川普，談的都是自己國家正在打的仗。會前，川普一度對尼坦雅胡表達不滿；會後，雙方都說談得不錯，但華府當天也有民眾上街抗議這趟行程。
items.thread_text:
澤倫斯基、尼坦雅胡訪美

美國共和黨參議員林賽·葛拉漢（Lindsey Graham）的告別式，把烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基（Zelenskyy）和以色列總理尼坦雅胡（Netanyahu）同一天帶到了華府。兩人分別到白宮見了川普（Trump），談的都是自己國家正在打的仗。

會前，川普一度對尼坦雅胡表達不滿；會後，尼坦雅胡說這次談話「非常棒」，澤倫斯基也說這是一次「好的會面」。華府當天還有民眾上街，抗議尼坦雅胡這趟行程。

—— 本則來自 BBC 與 Al Jazeera，2026 年 7 月 28 日發佈，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。

會前，川普一度對尼坦雅胡表達不滿，但會後尼坦雅胡形容這次談話「非常棒」；澤倫斯基那邊，也說這是一次「好的會面」。同一天，華府街頭有民眾聚集，抗議尼坦雅胡這趟訪問。

本則整理自 BBC 與 Al Jazeera 於 2026 年 7 月 28 日發佈的報導。

items.context: 由已故建築師法蘭克·蓋瑞（Frank Gehry）設計的古根漢美術館阿布達比分館，將在今年12月11日於薩迪亞特島（Saadiyat Island）正式開幕，是繼紐約、威尼斯、畢爾包之後的第四座古根漢美術館，也是其中規模最大的一座。
items.thread_text:

sources.summary: The duo’s groundbreaking 1985 tour reveals a strange collision of pop stardom and communism, a re-edit of Lindsay Anderson’s efforts that got him fired Here is a documentary that has a very important story to tell, maybe more important than it feels comfortable admitting. It’s about two separate subjects – or maybe three: Wham!, China and film-maker Lindsay Anderson. A superpower nervously edging towards western-style openness, a pop band nervously doing what needed to be done to make it big in the US, and a great film director, needing the money, taking on a project he didn’t really believe in. In 1985, Wham!’s beetle-browed manager Simon Napier-Bell had a cunning plan for how George Michael and Andrew Ridgeley could break the US: Wham! would be the first ever western pop band to perform in mainland China. They would play where the Beatles, the Stones and Elvis had never played, and the resulting global publicity would launch them into the US. (He was right – it did.) In our modern age, the movie and music businesses routinely consider China as the key element of the all-important Asian market, but in 1985, Michael and Ridgeley were the Kirk and Spock of the charts, going where no pop act had gone before. items.threads_text:
